label: scoped to keyspace
type: subject = a role grant, index, or statement; object = the keyspace (bucket.scope.collection path) it is confined to; means the subject has no effect outside that keyspace.
note: Promoted with server:keyspace. The predicate that makes Server's RBAC role scoping expressible: many of the 56 roles are parameterised by keyspace ('bucket_full_access[*]'), and without this the registry could name the role but not say what it applies to. The bracket notation itself is not modelled - it appears inside internal names as a literal - and is left on the watchlist.
